name: Hermiblaze
description: A limited Attack blade built around controlled overdrive. Hermiblaze turns direct victories into Blaze Stacks, raising its striking power while burning through its own stamina. The longer it stays aggressive, the harder it hits — and the faster it risks running dry.

ability.name: Blazing Ascension
ability.description: Every Attack win grants 1 Blaze Stack, up to 4. Each Blaze Stack adds 3% damage and increases Attack stamina cost by 1, up to 4 stacks. The Special consumes all Blaze Stacks.

abilities.name: Blazing Ascension
abilities.description: Every Attack win grants 1 Blaze Stack, up to 4. Each Blaze Stack adds 3% damage and increases Attack stamina cost by 1, up to 4 stacks. The Special consumes all Blaze Stacks.

abilities.name: Aether Rush
abilities.description: When both blades choose Attack, Hermiblaze deals 5% more damage, gains 1 Blaze Stack and pays extra stamina. It has a 20% chance to gain one additional Blaze Stack.

abilities.name: Celestial Blaze
abilities.description: A 3-hit finisher that consumes all Blaze Stacks. Each consumed stack adds 12% damage to the Special, up to 48% at 4 stacks. Firing it burns 5 additional stamina.

special_move.name: 🌠 Celestial Blaze
special_move.description: Hermiblaze detonates its stored momentum in three consecutive strikes. Base damage is 195; each Blaze Stack consumed adds 12% to the Special, up to +48% at four stacks.
flavour_texts: 🌠 **Celestial Blaze** — Hermiblaze tears open the sky!
☄️ **Final impact** — every stored spark detonates at once!
